_meta.why: NVIDIA's CUDA Binary Utilities tables cover the compute pipeline only. Shader SASS mined out of a graphics pipeline (Vulkan/D3D12, which is what tools/nvsass reads) uses a handful of instructions that never appear in a cubin and so are absent from the first-party list. They are kept in a separate file so data/opcodes.json stays purely first-party and regenerable.
_meta.confidence: These mnemonics are well attested in shader disassembly; the descriptions are reconstructed from observed usage and public reverse-engineering, not from NVIDIA documentation. Tooltips label them as such.

IPA.desc: Interpolate Pixel Attribute. Samples a rasterizer-interpolated varying out of attribute space at the current pixel. In a pixel shader the perspective divide is done explicitly afterwards: `a[0x7c]` holds 1/w, so the usual idiom is IPA of the attribute, `MUFU.RCP` of `a[0x7c]`, then `FMUL`.

ALD.desc: Attribute Load. Reads from attribute/varying space `a[...]` without interpolation - vertex inputs, and pixel-shader attributes that are already resolved.

AST.desc: Attribute Store. Writes to attribute/varying output space `a[...]`, e.g. a vertex shader publishing its outputs to the next stage.

AL2P.desc: Attribute Logical To Physical. Converts a logical attribute index into the physical `a[]` offset, used when a shader indexes varyings dynamically.

ISBERD.desc: Indexed Shader Buffer Entry Read. Reads a per-vertex/per-primitive entry from the shader buffer, used by geometry and tessellation stages to fetch input vertices.

OUT.desc: Emit stream output. Emits a vertex or ends a primitive in a geometry shader.

PIXLD.desc: Pixel Load. Reads per-pixel rasterizer state - coverage/sample mask, whether the pixel is live, centroid data.
